title: A reversible three-species mass-action continuum without a common factor
description: An exact reversible three-species mass-action system with one linkage class, ten complexes, ten reversible pairs, positive integer rates, and stoichiometric subspace R^3. Its positive orthant contains a compact algebraic ellipse of equilibria, while the coordinate polynomials of the vector field have gcd one over Q, R, and C. The archive includes the manuscript, raw reaction data, two independent exact verifiers, proof audits, and checksums. The claims are unreviewed; this citable disclosure date does not itself establish mathematical priority or correctness.
